extracted.intended_audience: researchers/authors reporting randomized clinical trials; journal editors, peer reviewers, and methodologists
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and checklist for writing and reporting randomized (clinical/experimental) trials to ensure complete, transparent, and standardized trial reports. Includes the core CONSORT 2025 statement and multiple extensions for specific trial designs, outcomes, and interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT 2025 Statement: updated guideline for reporting randomised trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated guideline for reporting randomised trials (CONSORT 2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary reporting guideline; checklist available for download from the CONSORT-SPIRIT website; published simultaneously in multiple journals (BMJ, JAMA, Lancet, Nat Med, PLoS Med). Use this as the core standard for reporting randomized trials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting guideline provided for?
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting of randomised trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the target reporting type — randomized trials — and directs users to the CONSORT 2025 checklist and explanation & elaboration papers for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applies to the whole report
rubrics_metrics.description: Applies to the whole report rather than individual sections only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CONSORT 2025 is intended to guide reporting across the entire trial report (title/abstract/introduction/methods/results/discussion), not just isolated sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study design applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Study design: Clinical trials, Experimental studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the types of studies to which the guideline principally applies (clinical/experimental randomized trials).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT 2025 Explanation and Elaboration
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation and elaboration paper accompanying CONSORT 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides extended explanation, rationale, examples, and elaboration for CONSORT checklist items; recommended to read alongside the checklist for implementation details.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Harms
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT Harms 2022 statement for reporting of harms in randomized trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension focused on adequate reporting of harms/adverse events; includes recommendations and elaboration to ensure harms are transparently reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Non-inferiority
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting of noninferiority and equivalence randomized trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides guidance specific to design, analysis, and interpretation considerations for noninferiority/equivalence trials (e.g., margin specification, analysis populations).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Cluster
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT 2010 extension: cluster randomised trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards tailored to trials where groups/clusters, not individuals, are randomized; addresses design, sample size, analysis accounting for clustering, and reporting of cluster-level details.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Herbal
rubrics_metrics.description: Elaborated CONSORT Statement for randomized, controlled trials of herbal interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides additional items and examples relevant to reporting herbal interventions (e.g., herbal product details, standardization).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Non-pharmacological treatment interventions
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT Statement for Randomized Trials of Nonpharmacologic Treatments (2017 update) and extension for abstracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance for reporting trials of non-drug interventions (procedures, devices, behavioural interventions), including intervention description and fidelity.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Abstracts
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT for reporting randomized controlled trials in journal and conference abstracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checklist and elaboration for transparent reporting in abstracts (what minimum information an abstract should contain).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Pragmatic Trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for improving the reporting of pragmatic trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on reporting design and conduct elements important for pragmatic (real-world) trials, such as eligibility, setting, and applicability/implementation aspects.

rubrics_metrics.name: STRICTA (Controlled trials of acupuncture)
rubrics_metrics.description: Revised Standards for Reporting Interventions in Clinical Trials of Acupuncture (STRICTA) as an extension to CONSORT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides intervention-specific reporting items for acupuncture trials (needling details, practitioner background, treatment regimen).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT PRO
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT PRO extension for reporting patient-reported outcomes in randomized trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on specifying PRO hypotheses, instruments, validity, timing, handling of missing data, and interpretation of PRO results.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-CENT
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for reporting N-of-1 trials (CENT) 2015 Statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides checklist items and elaboration for single-patient (N-of-1) randomized trial reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: TIDieR
rubrics_metrics.description: Template for Intervention Description and Replication (TIDieR) checklist and guide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A complementary checklist improving reporting of interventions so they can be understood, replicated, and implemented; recommended to use alongside CONSORT when interventions are described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simulation Research extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting Guidelines for Health Care Simulation Research: Extensions to the CONSORT and STROBE Statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides reporting items tailored to simulation-based research in healthcare (simulation design, scenarios, fidelity, outcomes).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT for pilot and feasibility trials
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT 2010 extension: reporting guidance for randomized pilot and feasibility trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies reporting items appropriate for pilot/feasibility studies (objectives, feasibility outcomes, progression criteria).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-CHM formulas
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT Extension for Chinese Herbal Medicine Formulas (2017).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommendations for reporting Chinese herbal medicine formula trials, including details of composition and preparation.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT for within person randomised trials
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT 2010 extension: within-person randomised trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance for trials in which different interventions are allocated to different body sites within the same participant (e.g., left vs right), addressing unit-of-analysis and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Equity
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT-Equity 2017 extension for better reporting of health equity in randomised trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages reporting relevant to equity (e.g., participant characteristics, subgroup analyses, applicability to disadvantaged groups).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-SPI
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting randomised trials of social and psychological interventions (CONSORT-SPI 2018 Extension).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tailored items for social/psychological interventions, addressing intervention description, fidelity, and contextual factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stepped wedge cluster randomised trials extension
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension of the CONSORT 2010 statement for stepped wedge cluster randomised trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses reporting of staggered roll-out designs, timing, cluster-period effects, and analysis adjustments.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT for multi-arm parallel-group randomised trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting multi-arm parallel-group randomized trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on reporting when more than two intervention groups are compared (e.g., multiplicity, allocation, comparisons).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT 2010 extension to randomised crossover trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting randomized crossover trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies items relevant to crossover designs including period effects, washout, and analysis accounting for within-subject correlation.

rubrics_metrics.name: CENT for TCM
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for N-of-1 trials for traditional Chinese medicine (CENT for TCM).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommendations for reporting N-of-1 trials in traditional Chinese medicine contexts with treatment-specific considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: STRICTOC
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for reporting interventions in clinical trials of cupping (STRICTOC) extending CONSORT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intervention-focused reporting items for cupping trials (procedure details, practitioners, treatment regimen).

rubrics_metrics.name: ACE Statement (adaptive designs extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adaptive designs CONSORT extension (ACE): checklist with explanation for reporting randomized trials that use an adaptive design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers adaptive features (interim analyses, adaptations, stopping rules), their rationale, and reporting of conduct and results of adaptations.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-AI
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT-AI: reporting guidelines for clinical trial reports for interventions involving artificial intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension addressing AI-specific reporting needs (e.g., algorithm description, versioning, training/validation, human–AI interaction).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-ROUTINE
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT-ROUTINE: extension for trials conducted using cohorts and routinely collected data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance for reporting trials that use existing cohorts or routinely collected data sources, covering data provenance, linkage, and limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-Outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidelines for Reporting Outcomes in Trial Reports (CONSORT-Outcomes 2022 Extension).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies improved reporting for outcomes selection, definition, measurement, and analysis/interpretation in trial reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-DEFINE
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT Dose-finding Extension (CONSORT-DEFINE) guidance for early phase dose-finding clinical trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enhances reporting quality and impact of early phase dose-finding trials (design, dose-escalation rules, decision criteria).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Factorial
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting factorial randomised trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides items specific to factorial designs (interaction reporting, allocation, interpretation of main/interaction effects).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-Surrogate
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting of surrogate endpoints in randomised controlled trial reports (CONSORT-Surrogate).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checklist and elaboration for transparent reporting when surrogate endpoints are used (validity, justification, limitations).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-iNeurostim
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting guidelines for randomized controlled trial reports of implantable neurostimulation devices (CONSORT-iNeurostim).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Device-specific reporting items including device description, implantation procedures, programming, and safety.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT CRXO
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting cluster randomised crossover trials (CONSORT CRXO).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses reporting needs for cluster randomised crossover designs, including cluster-period structure and analysis considerations.
